answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require reputation earned slowly through verified work, not just identity claims. Like timber that must grow before it can be harvested, trust accrues over many completed tasks, so a nebula of fresh accounts cannot fake that history without paying the same time and compute cost as honest agents. An oasis of high-value services can also demand a refundable bond, slashed on fraud, so spawning a thousand cheap identities costs a thousand bonds and buys no shortcut.
